build_commands.value: 三步构建: 1) hucx: ./autogen.sh && ./contrib/configure-opt --prefix=... --enable-mt --disable-numa --with-pic --enable-inc --without-java CC=gcc CXX=g++ FC=gfortran && make -jN && make install; 2) xucg: mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=... -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DUCG_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DUCG_ENABLE_MT=ON -DUCG_BUILD_WITH_UCX=... CC=gcc CXX=g++ FC=gfortran && make -jN && make install; 3) hmpi: ./autogen.pl && ./configure --prefix=... --with-platform=contrib/platform/mellanox/optimized --enable-mpi1-compatibility --with-ucx=... --with-ucg=... --with-pic CC=gcc CXX=g++ FC=gfortran && make -jN && make install

build_entry.value: 多组件仓库: 构建顺序为 hucx → xucg → hmpi，hucx和xucg需单独克隆编译后hmpi通过--with-ucx和--with-ucg引用

problems_encountered.problem: hucx编译config/parser.c时报错: ucs_has_spec_device声明返回uint32_t(line 88)但定义返回ucs_status_t(line 2202), 类型冲突导致编译失败. 该bug位于#if HAVE_IB的#else块中(无InfiniBand支持时编译的代码路径)
problems_encountered.solution: 安装libibverbs-devel和librdmacm-devel开发库, 使configure检测到InfiniBand支持并定义HAVE_IB宏, 从而编译#if HAVE_IB块中的正确实现(line 2081, 返回uint32_t与声明一致), 绕过#else块中的类型冲突bug

problems_encountered.problem: hmpi内置make check在构建阶段失败: ompi/mpi/fortran/mpiext-use-mpi-f08/mpiext_shortfloat_usempif08.h中MPI_Datatype派生类型在使用前未定义, gfortran 12.3.1报错
problems_encountered.solution: 改用README推荐的OSU Micro Benchmark测试方法(osu_init/osu_hello/osu_latency/osu_bw), 4个测试全部通过. 内置测试套件的Fortran编译问题非测试逻辑失败, 可能与gfortran版本或模块编译顺序有关.
